length: No statutory extension exists - the Local Tax Enabling Act (53 P.S. 6924.502(c)(1)) and its implementing regulation (12 Pa. Code Chapter 151) contain no extension-of-time provision, confirmed by a direct text search of the full act. Tax collection districts (Berkheimer, Keystone, Jordan Tax, and others) uniformly grant a filing extension as administrative practice only, tied to the federal or state extension, typically to October 15.
payment_threshold: Not extended - estimated tax is still due April 15 regardless of any extension paperwork
authority: 53 P.S. 6924.502(c)(1); 12 Pa. Code Chapter 151 (no extension provision in either)

form_name: Net Profits Occupational License Fee Return (single or dual tax district)
length: No statewide statute governs this - each of roughly 200 Kentucky cities, counties, and school districts sets its own ordinance. KRS 160.482-.488 and KRS 92.281 (the statutes most likely to govern) were checked directly and contain no due-date or extension language. Two sampled county ordinances (Jessamine, Logan) both show an automatic extension matching the federal extension period, on written request or a federal-extension copy by the original due date - disclosed as a 2-jurisdiction sample, not a verification of all ~200 jurisdictions.
payment_threshold: Not extended in either sampled ordinance - estimated fee still due by the original date
authority: No statewide statute - set by individual local ordinance; KRS 160.482-.488 and KRS 92.281 checked and contain no extension provision

form: Occupational Privilege Tax Return (monthly, quarterly, or annual)
form_name: Denver Occupational Privilege Tax Return
length: No extension mechanism found - confirmed by direct text search of over 60000 characters across Denver general tax information booklet and Tax Guide Topics 61 (Occupational Privilege Taxes), 30 (Filing Periods), and 68 (Rules and Regulations), none of which mention an extension of time to file at any filing frequency.
payment_threshold: N/A - no extension mechanism exists to extend
authority: Denver Revised Municipal Code sect 53-237 to 53-244

filer: Individuals, partnerships, associations, trusts, and estates conducting business in the city
form_name: City of Wilmington Net Profits Tax Return
length: Later filing is accepted, providing a copy of the IRS extension is filed with the Earned Income Tax Division on or before the initial filing due date. The unpaid balance of any return filed under extension is subject to a one-time 5 percent penalty, plus 1.5 percent per month interest from the original due date.
payment_threshold: N/A - payment is not extended; penalty and interest accrue on any unpaid balance from the original due date regardless of the extension
authority: City of Wilmington Earned Income Tax Regulations, Section 220 (Net Profits Tax) and Section 601a (penalty and interest on returns filed under extension)

form: 502 (same as state return - no separate local form)
form_name: Maryland Resident Income Tax Return (local tax computed on same form)
length: No separate local return or local extension exists. Local (county/Baltimore City) income tax is computed as a line item on the same Form 502 (residents) or Form 505 (nonresidents) used for state tax, and is covered by that same return's extension: an automatic 6-month extension via Form 502E (or no filing needed at all if a federal extension was obtained and no Maryland tax is due), up to 12 months for individuals outside the United States for reasonable cause.
payment_threshold: N/A - payment of the combined state and local tax is due in full by the original due date regardless of any extension
authority: Md. Code Ann., Tax-Gen. sect 10-823 (extension of time to file); Comptroller of Maryland, Administrative Release No. 4

filer: Plan administrators and plan sponsors (Form 5500, Form 5500-SF, Form 5500-EZ, Form 8955-SSA filers)
form_name: Application for Extension of Time to File Certain Employee Plan Returns
length: Automatic to the 15th day of the 3rd month after the return's normal due date (2.5 months), one-time only, if Form 5558 is filed on or before the normal due date. Exception: if the plan year and the employer's tax year are the same and the employer has been granted a federal income tax extension to a later date, the plan return is automatically extended to that date without filing Form 5558.
payment_threshold: N/A - Form 5500 series and Form 8955-SSA are informational returns with no associated tax payment
authority: IRC sect 6081 (extension of time for filing returns)

form_name: Occupational Privilege Tax Return
length: No extension mechanism found - the OPT return form (COA STM 0101) and its instructions contain a late filing penalty (10%) and interest (1%/month) line but no extension of time to file.
payment_threshold: N/A - no extension mechanism exists to extend

form_name: Occupational Privilege Tax Return
length: No extension mechanism found - confirmed by a direct text search of the city's full taxpayer guide (over 17,000 characters covering OPT filing frequency, thresholds, and remittance in detail), which contains no mention of an extension of time to file.
payment_threshold: N/A - no extension mechanism exists to extend

form_name: Occupational Privilege Tax Return
length: No extension mechanism found - the quarterly OPT return form contains a late filing penalty (10% or $15, whichever is greater) and interest (1%/month) line but no extension of time to file.
payment_threshold: N/A - no extension mechanism exists to extend

form_name: Occupational Privilege Tax Return
length: No extension mechanism found - the OPT return form contains a late filing penalty (10% or $100, whichever is greater) and interest (1.5%/month) line but no extension of time to file.
payment_threshold: N/A - no extension mechanism exists to extend
authority: City of Glendale Municipal Code (Occupational Privilege Tax)

filer: U.S. persons with transactions with foreign trusts, or large foreign gifts/bequests
form_name: Annual Return To Report Transactions With Foreign Trusts and Receipt of Certain Foreign Gifts
length: Rides on the filer's own income tax return extension - no separate form. For a calendar-year individual granted an extension of time to file an income tax return, Form 3520 is due no later than October 15 (the 15th day of the 10th month following the end of the tax year), which may differ from and is not tied to the actual extended due date of the income tax return itself.
payment_threshold: N/A - informational return, no independent tax payment

filer: Foreign trusts with a U.S. owner (filed by the trust or a U.S. agent)
form_name: Annual Information Return of Foreign Trust With a U.S. Owner
length: Separate extension required - does NOT ride on the U.S. owner's own Form 4868 or Form 7004. The foreign trust must file Form 7004 using its own employer identification number (EIN) by the 15th day of the 3rd month following the end of the trust's tax year to request an extension of time to file Form 3520-A.
payment_threshold: N/A - informational return, no independent tax payment

filer: U.S. officers, directors, and shareholders of certain foreign corporations
form_name: Information Return of U.S. Persons With Respect to Certain Foreign Corporations
length: Rides on the filer's own income tax return extension - filed as an attachment to that return, due by the due date (including extensions) of that return. No separate extension form.
payment_threshold: N/A - informational return, no independent tax payment

filer: 25%-foreign-owned U.S. corporations, and foreign corporations engaged in a U.S. trade or business
form_name: Information Return of a 25% Foreign-Owned U.S. Corporation or a Foreign Corporation Engaged in a U.S. Trade or Business
length: Rides on the reporting corporation's own Form 7004, filed by the regular due date of the corporation's income tax return. A foreign-owned U.S. disregarded entity with no income tax return of its own must file a pro forma Form 1120 with Form 5472 attached, and requests its extension by filing Form 7004 under the DE's own EIN by the regular due date of that pro forma return.
payment_threshold: N/A - informational return, no independent tax payment

filer: U.S. persons with interests in certain foreign partnerships
form_name: Return of U.S. Persons With Respect to Certain Foreign Partnerships
length: Rides on the filer's own income tax return extension when a return is required, filed by the due date (including extensions) of that return. If the filer has no income tax return filing requirement, Form 8865 is filed separately, at the time and place the filer would otherwise have filed an income tax return.
payment_threshold: N/A - informational return, no independent tax payment

filer: Specified individuals and domestic entities holding specified foreign financial assets above the applicable threshold
form_name: Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets
length: Rides on the filer's own income tax return extension - filed as an attachment to that return, due by the due date (including extensions) of that return. No separate extension form.
payment_threshold: N/A - informational return, no independent tax payment

filer: U.S. shareholders of a Passive Foreign Investment Company (PFIC)
form_name: Information Return by a Shareholder of a Passive Foreign Investment Company or Qualified Electing Fund
length: Rides on the filer's own income tax return extension - attached to that return and due by its due date, including extensions. A Qualified Electing Fund (QEF) election under section 1295 must likewise be made by the due date, including extensions, of the shareholder's income tax return for the relevant year.
payment_threshold: N/A - informational return/election, no independent tax payment

filer: Covered expatriates - former U.S. citizens and long-term residents
form_name: Initial and Annual Expatriation Statement
length: Rides on the filer's own income tax return extension. For the initial-year statement, the form is filed by the date the taxpayer's Form 1040-NR (or Form 1040/1040-SR) would have been due, including extensions, had one been required.
payment_threshold: N/A - informational return/election, no independent tax payment

form_name: Application for Automatic Extension of Time To File U.S. Individual Income Tax Return
length: Automatic 6-month extension. Bona fide residents of the USVI must file a paper Form 4868 with the V.I. Bureau of Internal Revenue (not the IRS). Nonresidents of the USVI with USVI-source income file separate extension requests with both the IRS and the VI BIR - the VI BIR will honor an extension timely filed with the IRS.
payment_threshold: N/A

tax_type: Income tax (Northern Mariana Territorial Income Tax)
form_name: Northern Mariana Territorial Income Tax - mirror-code extension
length: Follows the same extension mechanics as the federal code (Form 4868 for individuals, Form 7004 for businesses), filed with the CNMI Division of Revenue and Taxation instead of the IRS, since bona fide CNMI residents file their income tax return with the CNMI.
payment_threshold: N/A

jurisdiction: CNMI (local Wage and Salary Tax / Earnings Tax)
filer: Individuals and employers in the CNMI
form: Per CNMI Division of Revenue and Taxation regulations
form_name: CNMI Wage and Salary Tax / Earnings Tax extension
length: An extension to file exists "as provided by regulations prescribed by the Secretary" (4 CMC sect 1815(a)). The statute itself does not fix a specific length - that is set by regulation.
payment_threshold: N/A

form_name: CNMI Gross Revenue Tax
length: No extension to file exists (4 CMC sect 1815(b)) - only a waiver or abatement of the failure-to-file penalty for reasonable cause under 4 CMC sect 18134.
payment_threshold: N/A

filer: Qualified partnerships and S corporations electing CA PTE elective tax
form_name: Pass-Through Entity Elective Tax Payment Voucher
length: No extension available. Payment 1 (June 15 prepayment) and Payment 2 (balance) are both due without regard to any extension of time to file the entity's return. Election available only for taxable years beginning before January 1, 2026.
payment_threshold: N/A - full liability due by original date regardless of extension
authority: Cal. Rev. & Tax. Code sect 19900 et seq.; 2025 Instructions for Form FTB 3893

form_name: PTET Annual Return - Extension Request
length: Six months, requested online through the entity's Business Online Services account (no paper form). Extension to file only - all PTET must be paid by the original due date (generally March 15).
payment_threshold: N/A - full liability due by original date regardless of extension

filer: Electing pass-through entities (partnerships, S corporations, LLCs)
form_name: Pass-Through Business Alternative Income Tax Application for Extension to File Form PTE-100
length: Six months, filed online by the original due date. Extension to file Form PTE-100 only, not to pay. At least 80% of the BAIT liability must be paid by the original due date or the extension is retroactively denied.
payment_threshold: 80% of the BAIT liability must be paid by the original due date

form_name: Application for Extension of Time to File Connecticut Pass-Through Entity Tax Return
length: Six months, must be filed and paid electronically by the original due date (March 15 for calendar-year filers). Extension to file Form CT-PET (and to furnish Schedule CT K-1) only, not to pay. A federal Form 7004 extension does not automatically extend the Connecticut filing date.
payment_threshold: N/A - full liability due by original date regardless of extension
authority: Conn. Gen. Stat. sect 12-699 et seq.; Form CT-PET EXT Instructions (Rev. 12/25)

filer: Partnerships and S corporations electing to pay PTE tax
form_name: Illinois PTE Tax (Schedule B of Form IL-1065/IL-1120-ST)
length: No separate extension. PTE tax is reported on the entity's own Form IL-1065/IL-1120-ST, which gets Illinois' automatic 7-month filing extension (no form required). Payment of the PTE tax is still due by the original due date regardless of the automatic filing extension.
payment_threshold: Full tax due by original date; automatic filing extension does not extend payment

tax_type: Local school district / EMS income surtax
filer: Iowa individual income tax filers subject to a school district or EMS surtax
form_name: IA 1040 (school district surtax / EMS surtax line)
length: No separate return or extension. Computed as a percentage of state tax on IA 1040 line 19 and added to total state tax and local surtax, line 20 - covered by Iowa's own automatic 6-month extension if at least 90% of total tax (including the surtax) is paid by the original due date.
payment_threshold: 90% of total tax due (state tax plus surtax), same as the state's own extension test
authority: Iowa Code sect 257.21; Iowa Code sect 422.21; Iowa Admin. Code r. 701-700.5

jurisdiction: Oregon (TriMet & Lane Transit District self-employment tax)
filer: Self-employed individuals and partnerships with net earnings from services performed within the TriMet or LTD boundaries
form_name: TriMet/Lane Transit Self-Employment Tax Return
length: No separate extension form. A federal extension, or an Oregon individual income tax return extension, automatically extends Form OR-TM - check the box on the return. Payment is still due by the original due date regardless.
payment_threshold: N/A - full payment due by original date regardless of the filing extension

filer: Employers withholding Birmingham occupational tax on employee wages
form: Employer's Return of Occupational Tax Withheld
form_name: Birmingham Occupational Tax Withholding Return
length: Discretionary only. The Director of Finance may, for reasonable cause, extend the filing deadline by up to 30 days from the original due date. Interest and penalty continue to accrue during the extension period.
payment_threshold: N/A - interest and penalty accrue regardless of a granted extension
authority: City of Birmingham Occupational Tax Code, Ordinance No. 97-184, Article I, Section 6

form_name: Application for Automatic Extension of Time To File U.S. Individual Income Tax Return
length: Guam is a full mirror-code territory (48 U.S.C. sect 1421i(a)-(b)): the U.S. Internal Revenue Code is made applicable in Guam as the Guam Territorial income tax, substituting Guam for the United States and the Governor for the Secretary of the Treasury. Under this substitution the same Form 4868 automatic 6-month extension mechanics apply, filed with Guam's Department of Revenue and Taxation instead of the IRS - consistent with the IRS's own Form 4868 filing instructions, which direct permanent residents of Guam (grouped with the USVI) away from an IRS mailing address to Publication 570. This is a reasonable inference from the mirror-code statute, not a Guam-issued bulletin naming Form 4868 - no standalone extension procedure page was found on guamtax.com or myguamtax.com this session.
payment_threshold: N/A
authority: 48 U.S.C. sect 1421i(a)-(b); IRS Publication 570 (reasonable inference, not independently confirmed against a Guam-issued source)

filer: Partnerships, S corporations, and trusts electing the PTE excise
form_name: Entity Level Tax Extension Payment Worksheet
length: Automatic six-month extension to file Form 63D-ELT, following Massachusetts' standard simplified-extension pattern (TIR 16-10). Granted if at least 80% of the tax due for the year is paid by the original due date. Payment itself is not extended.
payment_threshold: 80% of the tax due must be paid by the original due date

filer: S corporations and partnerships electing the entity-level tax
form_name: Wisconsin Pass-Through Entity-Level Tax (Schedule 5S-ET / Schedule 3-ET)
length: No separate extension. The election and tax are reported on Schedule 5S-ET/3-ET attached to the entity's own Form 5S or Form 3. Wisconsin honors any IRS-granted federal extension (extending the Wisconsin due date to 30 days after the federal extended due date), and separately provides its own automatic extension of 7 months or to the federal due date, whichever is later. Payment is still due by the original due date.
payment_threshold: Full tax due by original date; filing extension does not extend payment

filer: Partnerships and S corporations electing the PTE tax
form_name: Minnesota Pass-Through Entity (PTE) Tax (Schedule PTE, attached to Form M3)
length: No separate extension. Form M3 (and the attached PTE election/Schedule PTE) receives an automatic six-month filing extension if the tax payable is paid by the regular due date; a longer federal extension extends the Minnesota due date to match. Filing extension only - an extension tax payment is still required by the regular due date.
payment_threshold: Tax payable must be paid by the regular due date to avoid penalties
authority: Minn. Stat. sect 289A.19, subd. 1 (automatic 6-month extension, conditioned on payment); sect 289A.08, subd. 7a (PTE election); 2025 Partnership Form M3 Instructions

filer: Partnerships and S corporations electing under the SALT Parity Act
form_name: Colorado Partnership and S Corporation and Composite Nonresident Income Tax Return
length: No separate extension. The SALT Parity Act election rides on Form DR 0106's own automatic six-month filing extension (to October 15 for calendar-year filers, no application required). Filing extension only - the tax liability, including any amount tied to the SALT Parity Act election, remains due by the original due date.
payment_threshold: Full tax due by original date; penalty and interest apply if payment criteria are not met
authority: C.R.S. sect 39-22-343; Income Tax Topics: SALT Parity Act (Oct. 2025)

form_name: Maryland Application for Extension to File Pass-Through Entity Income Tax Return
length: Filed by the 15th day of the 4th month after the tax year closes. Grants an automatic 7-month extension for S corporations and 6 months for other PTEs, but only if full payment of any balance due is submitted with the application and an IRS extension application was also filed. Maryland requires full payment up front, not merely an estimate.
payment_threshold: Full payment of any balance due required with the extension application
authority: Md. Code Ann., Tax-Gen. sect 10-102.1; 2024 Form 510 Pass-Through Entity Instructions

filer: Partnerships and S corporations electing to pay tax at the entity level
form_name: Georgia Election to Pay Tax at the Entity Level (checkbox on Form 700/600S)
length: No separate extension. The election is made directly on Form 700 (partnership) or Form 600S (S corporation). A federal automatic 6-month extension is honored without a separate Georgia filing (O.C.G.A. sect 48-7-57); Form IT-303 is used only if no federal extension was obtained. The Extension box on Form 700/600S must be checked or a late-filing penalty applies even with a valid extension.
payment_threshold: Full tax due by original statutory due date regardless of extension
authority: O.C.G.A. sect 48-7-57; 2023 IT-711 Partnership Income Tax Booklet

filer: Partnerships and S corporations electing to pay small business income tax at the entity level
form_name: Application for Automatic Extension of Time to File Corporation, Partnership, and Exempt Organization Returns
length: No separate PTE-specific extension. Form 120/165EXT, the same extension form used for the entity's regular return, explicitly covers Form 165 filers who elected to pay tax at the entity level. Automatic extension. Payment is still due by the original due date regardless of the filing extension.
payment_threshold: Full tax due by original date; filing extension does not extend payment

filer: Electing pass-through entities filing Form IT 4738
form_name: Ohio Electing Pass-Through Entity Income Tax Return (IT 4738)
length: No separate Ohio extension form. Ohio allows IT 4738 filers the same extended filing deadline as the federal government; a copy of the federal extension must be attached to the IT 4738 return when filed. If the federal extension ends before Ohio's regular due date, no additional time is gained. Payment is still due by the original due date - the extension is to file only.
payment_threshold: Full tax due by original due date regardless of extension
authority: Ohio Rev. Code sect 5747.38; Pass-Through Entities & Fiduciaries FAQ (Ohio Dept. of Taxation)

form: N/A - no separate PTET extension form
form_name: Virginia Pass-Through Entity Tax Return (Form 502PTET)
length: No separate extension mechanism. Form 502PTET receives an automatic extension to 6 months after its own due date, or 30 days after the federal extended due date, whichever is later.
payment_threshold: Full tax due by the 15th day of the 4th month after the close of the entity's taxable year, regardless of extension
authority: Va. Code Ann. sect 58.1-390.3; Form 502PTET Instructions (Virginia Dept. of Taxation)

jurisdiction: South Carolina (Active Trade or Business election)
filer: Electing partnerships (SC1065) and S corporations (SC1120S) computing tax on Form I-435
form_name: South Carolina Application for Automatic Extension of Time (Form SC8736)
length: No separate PTET extension form. The election rides on the entity's own return extension, Form SC8736, filed via MyDORWAY, granting up to 6 months.
payment_threshold: "No extension of time for payment of your Partnership Tax" - full tax due by the original due date regardless of extension
authority: S.C. Code Ann. sect 12-6-545; Form I-435 Instructions (South Carolina Dept. of Revenue)

form: N/A - requested through Michigan Treasury Online (MTO), no paper form number
form_name: Michigan Flow-Through Entity Tax Annual Return (Form 5772)
length: No separate paper extension form. Extension requested through the MTO FTE Dashboard, extending the filing deadline 6 months (to September 30 for calendar-year filers).
payment_threshold: Full tax due by the original filing deadline regardless of extension
authority: Michigan Flow-Through Entity Tax Act, Mich. Pub. Act 135 of 2021; Michigan Treasury FTE guidance

filer: Electing partnerships (Form D-403) and S corporations (Form CD-401S)
form: D-410P (partnership) / CD-419 (S corporation) - entity's own return extension
form_name: North Carolina Application for Extension for Filing Partnership, Estate, or Trust Tax Return (Form D-410P)
length: No separate PTET extension form. The election rides on the entity's own return extension (Form D-410P or CD-419), an automatic 6-month extension. The PTET election itself must be made by the return's due date, including extensions.
payment_threshold: Interest is charged on taxes paid after the original due date even if a filing extension is granted
authority: N.C. Gen. Stat. sect 105-131.1A (S corporation election); sect 105-154.1 (partnership election); 2024 D-403A Partnership Instructions (NCDOR)

filer: Electing partnerships (Form 514) and S corporations (Form 512-S), election made on Form 586
form_name: Oklahoma Application for Extension of Time to File - Pass-Through Entity (Form 504-PTE)
length: Separate extension application required. Form 504-PTE (in place of the entity's usual Form 504-C) grants an extension of up to 6 months.
payment_threshold: At least 90% of the tax must be paid by the original due date to avoid penalty - the extension does not extend the time to pay
authority: Okla. Stat. tit. 68, sect 2355.1P-4; 2025 Form 514-Pkt Instructions (Oklahoma Tax Commission)

filer: Electing partnerships and S corporations under La. R.S. 47:287.732.2
form: N/A - no PTE-specific extension form identified
form_name: Louisiana Partnership Return of Income (Form IT-565), automatic extension
length: No PTE-specific extension form identified. The general partnership return (Form IT-565) receives an automatic 6-month filing extension (to November 15 for calendar-year filers), with no separate application required. Reasonable inference, not a direct quote confirming PTE electors specifically - Louisiana's guidance does not carve PTE electors out of this general rule.
payment_threshold: "An extension does not relieve you of your obligation to pay all tax amounts due by the original due date"
authority: La. R.S. 47:287.732.2; 2025 IT-565i Partnership Return Instructions (Louisiana Dept. of Revenue)

filer: Electing entities reporting on Schedule PTE, attached to RI-1065, RI-1120S, or RI-1041
form_name: Rhode Island Automatic Extension Request (Form RI-7004)
length: No PTE-specific extension form identified. The entity's own return extension, Form RI-7004, grants an automatic 6-month extension (7 months for June 30 year-end C corporations). Reasonable inference, not a direct quote naming Schedule PTE specifically.
payment_threshold: Full payment of the tax reasonably estimated to be due must be submitted with Form RI-7004 for the extension to be effective
authority: R.I. Gen. Laws sect 44-11-2.3; Form RI-7004 Instructions (Rhode Island Div. of Taxation)

form: N/A - automatic extension, no application required
form_name: Utah automatic extension of time to file TC-65 / TC-20S
length: No separate extension mechanism and no application required - Utah grants an automatic 6-month extension to file TC-65/TC-20S.
payment_threshold: "This is NOT an extension of time to pay your taxes" - full tax due by the original due date regardless of extension
authority: Utah Code Ann. sect 59-10-1403.2(2); 2025 TC-20S Instructions (Utah State Tax Commission)
